hypotheses.D1_leave_pair_out_transfer_improves_with: The best later-layer mean leave-pair-out family transfer exceeds layer 0 by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.D2_some_layer_has_useful_family_transfer: At least one layer reaches mean leave-pair-out family transfer of 0.50.
hypotheses.D3_some_layer_has_a_robust_held_out_floo: At least one layer reconstructs every held-out lexical-pair context with fidelity at least 0.25.
hypotheses.D4_same_family_alignment_emerges: At least one layer's same-family rank-8 subspace alignment exceeds different-family alignment by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.D5_same_pair_cross_corpus_transfer_excee: Same-pair cross-corpus transfer exceeds leave-pair-out family transfer at every layer.
hypotheses.D6_individual_paths_remain_low_rank_acro: Every layer and context has path rank-to-90%-energy at most 16.
hypotheses.D7_in_sample_family_subspaces_remain_com: At every layer, rank-32 family bases reconstruct at least 75% of every observed member path.
hypotheses.D8_semantic_reuse_has_a_distinct_best_la: The best leave-pair-out layer exceeds both adjacent layers by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.D9_late_layers_are_more_semantic_than_la: Mean leave-pair-out transfer averaged over layers 8-11 exceeds layer 0 by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.D10_no_layer_has_strong_universal_family: No layer attains a worst-context leave-pair-out fidelity of 0.50.
